source_quotes: identify the rule of the callgraph for all others
I want to view the call graphs in code traversing
overlap_check: Draft 26 (every modality has a call graph rule) defines what a graph is per modality; this governs how system facts are generated and kept honest. New.

payload.name: Facts About the Code Are Generated, Checked for Drift and Honest About Limits
payload.description: Call graphs and route registries that mirror the code are produced by a deterministic extractor with a drift check, show their limits on screen, and never guess an edge.

principles.name: A copied fact drifts
principles.description: A hand-kept copy of what the code does stops being true; a generated one can be checked.

heuristics.condition: a label is missing from its registry
heuristics.action: flag it instead of hiding it

heuristics.condition: a name is defined more than once
heuristics.action: leave it out of reachability and say so

decision_rules.name: Generate, do not copy
decision_rules.outcome: extract it from the source with a deterministic tool with no timestamps; never copy it by hand

decision_rules.name: Check for drift
decision_rules.outcome: give the extractor a check mode that exits non-zero when the asset differs, and run it in review

requires.name: code_callgraph
requires.purpose: compare the extracted graph with the code's own call graph

decision_rules.name: State the limits
decision_rules.condition: the extractor is static and name-based
decision_rules.outcome: write the limits into the asset and show them on screen; leave ambiguous names out and never guess an edge

decision_rules.name: Keep the unattached
decision_rules.condition: a call site is reached by no stage
decision_rules.outcome: keep it and mark it unattached; mark labels absent from the registry

decision_rules.name: Create at boot, retry until ensured
decision_rules.condition: system facts cost no model call
decision_rules.outcome: create or refresh them at boot without blocking boot, and retry until every graph is ensured
